messages:
Rui Tan: Quick idea for next PLG push: run targeted office-hours (30m) by vertical + a tiny starter-credit bundle (75 tokens) + 3 vertical prompt templates. aim: shorten time-to-first-success and capture vertical intent tags.
Priya Shah: nice. what verticals are we thinking?
Rui Tan: dev tools, ecommerce, and internal docs. small cohorts (500 each).
Alex Moreno: routing question 94 leads from office-hours signups -> where do they land? sales, growth, or support?
Toby Reed: for cohort experiments, route to growth, but add trigger to surface high-touch domains to sales. low-friction followup flow from support chat for everyone else.
Priya Shah: tracking: need events for signup, credit_redeemed, template_used, first_success (define as any generation >= 0.6 quality score?), and support_contacted.
Alex Moreno: keep the quality score definition simple for now: first_success = promptpack_response && tokens_used > 0 && user_rated >= 4 OR no-rating fallback: request_length > 20 chars.
Rui Tan: ok. we'll A/B the credit amount: 75 vs 150 tokens. measure delta on "time to 5 requests" and "conversion to paid" at 14 days.
ops-bot: reminder: feature-flag "cohort_officehours_2026q2" created and off by default.
Toby Reed: creative needs: 1 signup landing page per vertical, 3 copy variants per vertical, and 1 short gif demo showing installing the promptpack and running two requests. can design do that in 48h?
Priya Shah: yes, design confirmed. will hand over GIFs by EOD Tue.
Alex Moreno: routing rules (draft):
- Signup with enterprise email -> create SFDC lead, tag: "officehours-vertical"
- Signup non-enterprise -> growth inbox + add to nurture drip (48h, 5-day cadence)
- If user redeems >150 tokens -> flag for sales outreach

Also webhook -> #growth-officehours with event payload {campaign, vertical, email_domain, redeemed_tokens}.
Rui Tan: good. we should also attach a small post-launch benchmark template to the launch post: hypothesis, cohort size & channels, primary metrics, cost per cohort (approx tokens + infra), and recommended next step.
Toby Reed: cost calc: estimate tokens redeemed + average token cost 0.0008 USD/token + ops uplift 15%. I'll draft a sample table.
priya shah: subject lines to test: "Build an ecommerce recommender in 10 requests" vs "Office hours: ship an LLM flow in 30 minutes". first for cold, second for warm.
Alex Moreno: add a control arm with no-credit invite (just office-hours) to test the incremental lift from credits.
Rui Tan: timeline: enable flag Mon, creative ready Tue EOD, soft-launch Wed 9am PT to 1500 users, run 10 days. postmortem and benchmark doc due 1 week after end.
ops-bot: scheduled: feature flag enabled 2026-05-04 09:00 PT if not manually toggled.
Toby Reed: I'll post the launch checklist in #marketing-prod and pin assets. assign follow-ups to @Priya, @Alex, and @Rui.
Rui Tan: thanks all. goal: show a clear lift in time-to-first-success and a playbook we can replicate for other verticals. :rocket:
